criteria.requirement: Implement statemachine.journal.dumps_journal(results,*,max_records=10000) and loads_journal(document,*,max_records=10000) using completed EventResult/Call/Snapshot types. Schema1 records contain contiguous index, event/args/kwargs, passed/error, before/after configurations and actual result/error; support empty journals and Unicode JSON-compatible values. Validate version, exact record/state structure, counts, order, statuses, duplicate JSON keys, finite values and immediate event control policies. Restore independent data records without importing machine classes, eval or sending events. Unsupported callback result serialization must fail, not stringify objects.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
